name: RC-B10-0366/2025 – After § 7 – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text: 7b. Calls on the Member States to support and actively promote the establishment of a new paradigm in the fight against drug trafficking, recognising that punitive approaches have failed to achieve sustainable results and have been associated with widespread human rights violations, and instead prioritise peace, human rights, and sustainable livelihoods, so that communities in areas growing coca and other illicit crops can finally live in dignity, security and lasting peace;
